objective: Screen whether the retrieval coverage gained by expanding BM25 context from 10 to 40 chunks improves required-claim answer quality enough to justify its token and latency cost.

scope.case_selection: All 15 reviewed answerable multi-hop cases in technical-papers-v1; no outcome-based subsampling.
excluded: Prompt-injection variants are excluded because the intervention is retrieved-slate size, not attack resistance.
Unanswerable and single-hop cases are deferred until this mechanism probe clears its advance gate.

execution.arm_processes: Launch both arms contemporaneously with one worker per arm and ascending case order.
execution.ordering_limitation: Exact request interleaving is service-dependent rather than a randomized treatment sequence; the exact pinned snapshot limits model-alias drift.
execution.resume_policy: Each arm writes an immutable run manifest and atomically checkpoints completed case rows. Resume only with the identical preflight and run contract.

endpoints.primary: Human-approved paired task pass over all 15 cases.
secondary: Automated required-claim task pass before human review.
Fully supported answers and contradiction detection.
Candidate and judge input/output tokens and p50/p95 latency.
Conservative standard-token cost estimate and cost per additional passing answer.
endpoints.paired_analysis: Report the full 2-by-2 task-pass table, gains, losses, ties, absolute paired difference, and McNemar exact p-value. Do not describe a 15-case result as definitive population evidence.

exploratory_slice.interpretation: These five cases identify the retrieval mechanism but are not a separately powered confirmatory sample.

required: The k=40 arm has more human-approved task-pass gains than losses against k=10.
Human review finds no increase in unsupported or contradictory answers.
Both arms complete within their individual caps and the combined conservative ceiling remains at or below $0.75.
advance_gate.on_pass: Advance to a separately preregistered confirmation that includes single-hop and unanswerable cases.
advance_gate.on_fail: Keep k=10 as the default and publish the larger-slate result as a negative mechanism probe.

review_gate: Automated judgments remain provisional. No public answer-quality aggregate from this experiment is approved until a companion decision artifact covers all 30 arm-by-case records and is explicitly approved by the project owner.
limitations: The corpus contains only two technical papers.
The candidate and automated judge use the same model snapshot, creating correlated self-evaluation risk.
The experiment is powered as a screening probe, not a conclusive statistical comparison.
Provider billing data is not returned by the Responses API; reported dollar cost is a conservative estimate from recorded tokens and the versioned standard-price contract.
